rules.sentence: years employed is above 4.52 AND loan term (years) is at most 0.90 AND loan term (years) is above 0.81
rules.caveat: Narrow range on 'loan term (years)' (0.81 to 0.90), bounded from both sides by this single decision tree. Treat as a lower-confidence pattern worth re-checking on more data before codifying into policy, unlike the other rules here which use one wide threshold per feature.
